evidence: Issue 'Negative text_tokens in prompt_tokens_details when image caching is used with Gemini multimodal model' (lizhen921, 2026-01-07, closed). Body: 'the second request that hits the cache returns negative values for text_tokens in prompt_tokens_details'; text_tokens = -3327.
correction: Precise: LiteLLM v1.80.10's Gemini usage mapping subtracted cached tokens and produced text_tokens=-3327 on a cache hit; the issue itself states the expected invariant 'text_tokens should always be a non-negative integer'.

evidence: #1745 (2020-11-05): 'I have a large commit that has 926 changed files ... I got 300.' PR #2939 'Make Commit.files return PaginatedList' merged 2024-05-28, 'Fixes #1745'.
correction: Cap originated from GitHub's 300-file first page; PyGithub did not follow pagination links (up to 3000 files). Fix merged 2024-05-28.

evidence: PR #3195 (SamMorrowDrums, merged 2026-09-01) Summary: 'Detect when GitHub accepts an issue create or update request but omits requested labels'; compares requested labels with the create/PATCH response 'without an additional readback'. Fixes #3160.
correction: Note: the check uses the write response, not a separate read-after-write; #3160 found the drop only 'by reading back the issue's labels'.

evidence: #2347 (2026-04-20): list_pull_request_reviews 'only returns the first page of results (~30 reviews)... no indication in the response that results were truncated'. PR #2367 merged 2026-05-12 adds page/perPage.
correction: Fix exposes pagination params (default still page=1, per_page=30); it does not auto-paginate.

evidence: PR #3419 Why: 'The Contents API returns files over 1 MB with "content": "" and "encoding": "none"'; server failed with 'unsupported content encoding: none'. Merged 2026-10-15; regression since v1.10.0.
correction: This was a loud failure (isError: true), not a silent wrong result; do not cite it as a silent fault. It is a regression since v1.10.0 that the existing mocked tests missed.

evidence: Heading '100x errors': 'Sometimes Yahoo mixes up currencies e.g. $/cents or £/pence. So some prices are 100x wrong.' Random errors 'detected with scipy module'.
correction: 'hand-built statistical detector' is our paraphrase; the page says only that scattered 100x errors are detected using scipy. The year (2026) refers to when the docs page was accessed.

evidence: Compatibility mode: 'By default, using compatibility mode, the text attribute ... is truncated to 140 characters, as needed. When this truncation occurs, the truncated attribute ... will be True'.
correction: The truncation is flagged (truncated=True plus an ellipsis and permalink), so it is not fully silent. The behavior comes from the Twitter API default that Tweepy surfaces. The 2023 date is unconfirmed [verify].

evidence: Refusals: 'Since a refusal does not necessarily follow the schema you have supplied in response_format, the API response will include a new field called refusal'.
correction: Rephrase as: a refusal need not follow the supplied schema, so the API signals it with a separate refusal field instead of schema-conforming output.
